description: Search SoundCloud, read the global or genre New & Hot charts, export an artist catalog, resolve track/playlist/profile URLs, collect comments, or list followers.

artistUrls.description: Artist profile URLs, usernames, or numeric user IDs. Used by artistTracks and followers modes.
artistUrls.sectionDescription: Controls what is exported for each artist profile. The profile row is always included in artistTracks.
artistUrls.title: Artists

chartGenre.description: Global New & Hot returns up to 100 tracks. Genre values use SoundCloud's current trending-by-genre lists (about 50 tracks each).
chartGenre.title: Chart genre

includeAlbums.description: Include the artist's albums/EPs as playlist rows.
includeAlbums.title: Include albums

includePlaylistTracks.description: For playlist URLs, hydrate and emit every track (not just the first five).
includePlaylistTracks.title: Expand playlist tracks

includePlaylists.description: Include the artist's playlists as playlist rows.
includePlaylists.title: Include playlists

includeTopTracks.description: Include SoundCloud's small top-tracks list for each artist.
includeTopTracks.title: Include top tracks

includeUserProfile.description: For artist URLs in mode=byUrl, emit the profile row before the tracks.
includeUserProfile.title: Include artist profile row

includeWebProfiles.description: Add the artist's public social/web profile links to the profile row.
includeWebProfiles.title: Include web profiles

maxItems.description: Hard cap on dataset rows. SoundCloud search still returns at most 300 rows per query; charts and per-artist sections have their own source limits.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

minLikeCount.description: Drop track/playlist rows below this like count after fetching. 0 means no filter.
minLikeCount.title: Minimum likes

minPlayCount.description: Drop track/playlist rows below this play count after fetching. 0 means no filter.
minPlayCount.title: Minimum plays

mode.description: Choose the intent. Keyword search, New & Hot charts, an artist catalog, specific URLs, track comments, or an artist's followers.
enumTitles: Search by keyword - tracks, users, playlists or albums
Charts - global New & Hot or a genre trending list
Artist catalog - profile, tracks, albums, playlists
mode.title: What to collect

relationship.description: For mode=followers, collect the artist's followers or the accounts the artist follows.
relationship.title: Follower relationship

resolveStreamUrls.description: Add a playable signed stream URL plus protocol, preview and expiry fields. Signed URLs expire after about two hours. Turn off for large runs if you only need the stable API endpoint.
resolveStreamUrls.sectionDescription: Stream resolution and the overall record cap.
resolveStreamUrls.title: Resolve playable stream URLs

searchGenre.description: Optional SoundCloud genre filter for track and playlist searches. Leave as any genre to search everything. This is a real SoundCloud filter, not a client-side guess.
searchGenre.sectionDescription: Optional refinements for mode=search. Genre is applied by SoundCloud; sort and minimum counts are applied to the fetched rows.
searchGenre.title: Genre filter

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords or artist names (mode=search). Example: lofi, techno, ambient jazz.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

searchType.description: What kind of results to return (mode=search).
searchType.title: Search result type

sortBy.description: How to order the rows already fetched. SoundCloud search itself is relevance-ordered, so this is a client-side sort of that result set.
sortBy.title: Sort fetched rows

startUrls.description: Track, playlist/album, or artist URLs. Numeric track IDs are also accepted. Used by mode=byUrl.

url.description: SoundCloud track, playlist, album, user, or search URL.
url.title: URL

startUrls.sectionDescription: Playlist URLs export the playlist row and, when enabled, every track in it. Artist URLs export the profile and uploaded tracks.
startUrls.title: SoundCloud URLs or IDs

trackUrls.description: Tracks whose public comments should be collected. Used by mode=comments.

url.description: SoundCloud track URL used for comments mode.
url.title: URL

trackUrls.sectionDescription: Comment collection and follower/following collection. These modes keep the track or artist context on every row.
trackUrls.title: Track URLs or IDs

title: SoundCloud Scraper Input
